description: The captured Google Merchant API schema confirms that variants of the same product share an identifier. That gives the catalogue offer a concrete rule to test against supplied family labels. The next step is to run the existing merchant controls and turn the observed findings into a bilingual sample for eligible inbound inquiries. Google feed acceptance remains unverified. Commercial feedback has five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. Treasury is unfunded with CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. The proposed CAD 60 commission still requires operator approval and administrative order acceptance.
